verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway supports centralized AI provider credential management via AI Vault (referencing secrets in AWS Secrets Manager, Vault, etc. instead of literal values) and AI Auth Strategy entities that let platform engineers declare inbound authentication (including IdP-based) for AI Models/Agents/MCP servers without exposing raw provider keys. This covers keeping upstream provider keys hidden and centralizing credential storage/auth, which aligns with the story's core intent. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an API/workflow to 'mint' distinct gateway-issued keys per team/app (e.g., consumer-level key issuance analogous to Kong Gateway API-key consumers) and independent/hands-on corroboration of this key-minting workflow specifically for AI Gateway.
